title: "Single-cell Circadian Simulation with Biological Replicates"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-16"

# Simulation function

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(circular)
  library(dplyr)
  library(Matrix)
})

simulate_sc_circadian_replicates <- function(
  n_genes_per_module = rep(500, 8),
  n_replicates = 3,
  cells_per_sample = 100,
  ZT_levels = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20),
  phase_kappa_true = 10,
  phase_shift_hours = 3,
  delta_phase_tol_hours = 1.5,
  amp_log2fc_gain = 1.2,
  amp_log2fc_loss = -1.2,
  sigma_rep_mesor = 0.10,
  sigma_rep_phase_hour = 0.30,
  log_sf_sd = 0.45,
  mean_mu = 0.8,
  mean_sd = 1.0,
  amp_meanlog = -0.7,
  amp_sdlog = 0.45,
  disp_meanlog = -1.5,
  disp_sdlog = 0.4,
  dropout_b0 = 1.0,
  dropout_b1 = -0.8,
  p_alpha = 5,
  p_beta = 2,
  kappa_min = 3,
  kappa_max = 30,
  seed = 42,
  show_progress = TRUE
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  wrap_angle <- function(x) x %% (2 * pi)
  circ_diff <- function(a, b) (a - b + pi) %% (2 * pi) - pi

  G <- sum(n_genes_per_module)
  module <- rep(0:7, times = n_genes_per_module)
  groups <- c("cond_1", "cond_2")
  reps <- paste0("rep", seq_len(n_replicates))

  sample_meta <- expand.grid(
    group = groups,
    replicate = reps,
    ZT_bin_num = ZT_levels,
    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    arrange(group, replicate, ZT_bin_num) %>%
    mutate(
      ZT_bin = factor(paste0("ZT", ZT_bin_num), levels = paste0("ZT", ZT_levels)),
      sample = paste(group, replicate, paste0("ZT", ZT_bin_num), sep = "_")
    )

  cell_meta <- sample_meta[rep(seq_len(nrow(sample_meta)), each = cells_per_sample), ]
  cell_meta$cell <- paste0("Cell", seq_len(nrow(cell_meta)))
  N <- nrow(cell_meta)

  theta_center <- cell_meta$ZT_bin_num / 24 * 2 * pi
  theta_true <- numeric(N)

  if (show_progress) pb_phase <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = N, style = 3)
  for (i in seq_len(N)) {
    theta_true[i] <- as.numeric(
      circular::rvonmises(
        1,
        mu = circular::circular(theta_center[i]),
        kappa = phase_kappa_true
      )
    ) %% (2 * pi)
    if (show_progress) setTxtProgressBar(pb_phase, i)
  }
  if (show_progress) close(pb_phase)

  p_cell <- rbeta(N, p_alpha, p_beta)
  kappa_i <- kappa_min + (kappa_max - kappa_min) * p_cell
  theta_obs <- numeric(N)

  if (show_progress) pb_obs <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = N, style = 3)
  for (i in seq_len(N)) {
    theta_obs[i] <- as.numeric(
      circular::rvonmises(
        1,
        mu = circular::circular(theta_true[i]),
        kappa = kappa_i[i]
      )
    ) %% (2 * pi)
    if (show_progress) setTxtProgressBar(pb_obs, i)
  }
  if (show_progress) close(pb_obs)

  log_sf <- rnorm(N, 0, log_sf_sd)
  sf <- exp(log_sf)

  M_g <- rnorm(G, mean_mu, mean_sd)
  A_base <- rlnorm(G, amp_meanlog, amp_sdlog)
  phi_base <- runif(G, 0, 2 * pi)
  alpha_g <- rlnorm(G, disp_meanlog, disp_sdlog)

  A_cond_1 <- A_base
  A_cond_2 <- A_base
  phi_cond_1 <- phi_base
  phi_cond_2 <- phi_base

  phase_shift_rad <- phase_shift_hours / 24 * 2 * pi
  delta_phase_tol_rad <- delta_phase_tol_hours / 24 * 2 * pi

  for (g in seq_len(G)) {
    m <- module[g]

    if (m == 0) {
      A_cond_1[g] <- 0
      A_cond_2[g] <- 0
    }
    if (m == 2) {
      A_cond_1[g] <- 0
      A_cond_2[g] <- A_base[g]
    }
    if (m == 3) {
      A_cond_1[g] <- A_base[g]
      A_cond_2[g] <- 0
    }
    if (m == 4) {
      A_cond_2[g] <- A_base[g] * 2^amp_log2fc_gain
      phi_cond_2[g] <- wrap_angle(
        phi_base[g] + runif(1, -0.5 * delta_phase_tol_rad, 0.5 * delta_phase_tol_rad)
      )
    }
    if (m == 5) {
      A_cond_2[g] <- A_base[g] * 2^amp_log2fc_loss
      phi_cond_2[g] <- wrap_angle(
        phi_base[g] + runif(1, -0.5 * delta_phase_tol_rad, 0.5 * delta_phase_tol_rad)
      )
    }
    if (m == 6) {
      phi_cond_2[g] <- wrap_angle(phi_base[g] - phase_shift_rad)
    }
    if (m == 7) {
      phi_cond_2[g] <- wrap_angle(phi_base[g] + phase_shift_rad)
    }
  }

  sample_ids <- sample_meta$sample

  sample_mesor <- matrix(
    rnorm(G * length(sample_ids), 0, sigma_rep_mesor),
    nrow = G,
    ncol = length(sample_ids),
    dimnames = list(paste0("Gene", seq_len(G)), sample_ids)
  )

  sample_phase_hour <- rnorm(length(sample_ids), 0, sigma_rep_phase_hour)
  names(sample_phase_hour) <- sample_ids
  sample_phase_rad <- sample_phase_hour / 24 * 2 * pi

  sample_idx <- match(cell_meta$sample, sample_ids)
  group <- cell_meta$group
  Y <- matrix(0, nrow = G, ncol = N)

  if (show_progress) pb_counts <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = G, style = 3)
  for (g in seq_len(G)) {
    amp_vec <- ifelse(group == "cond_1", A_cond_1[g], A_cond_2[g])
    phi_vec <- ifelse(group == "cond_1", phi_cond_1[g], phi_cond_2[g])
    phi_vec <- wrap_angle(phi_vec + sample_phase_rad[sample_idx])
    mesor_vec <- M_g[g] + sample_mesor[g, sample_idx]

    log_mu <- mesor_vec + amp_vec * cos(theta_true - phi_vec) + log_sf
    mu <- exp(log_mu)
    pi_drop <- plogis(dropout_b0 + dropout_b1 * log(mu + 1))
    is_drop <- rbinom(N, 1, pi_drop)
    counts <- rnbinom(N, mu = mu, size = 1 / alpha_g[g])
    counts[is_drop == 1] <- 0
    Y[g, ] <- counts

    if (show_progress) setTxtProgressBar(pb_counts, g)
  }
  if (show_progress) close(pb_counts)

  rownames(Y) <- paste0("Gene", seq_len(G))
  colnames(Y) <- cell_meta$cell

  delta_phase <- mapply(function(x, y) circ_diff(y, x), phi_cond_1, phi_cond_2)
  delta_amp_log2fc <- log2((A_cond_2 + 1e-8) / (A_cond_1 + 1e-8))

  gene_meta <- data.frame(
    gene = rownames(Y),
    module = module,
    M = M_g,
    alpha = alpha_g,
    A_base = A_base,
    phi_base = phi_base,
    A_cond_1 = A_cond_1,
    A_cond_2 = A_cond_2,
    phi_cond_1 = phi_cond_1,
    phi_cond_2 = phi_cond_2,
    delta_amp_log2fc = delta_amp_log2fc,
    delta_phase_rad = delta_phase,
    delta_phase_hour = delta_phase / (2 * pi) * 24
  )

  gene_meta$check_m4 <- with(gene_meta,
    module == 4 & delta_amp_log2fc > 1 & abs(delta_phase_hour) < delta_phase_tol_hours + 1e-8
  )
  gene_meta$check_m5 <- with(gene_meta,
    module == 5 & delta_amp_log2fc < -1 & abs(delta_phase_hour) < delta_phase_tol_hours + 1e-8
  )
  gene_meta$check_m6 <- with(gene_meta,
    module == 6 & abs(delta_phase_hour + phase_shift_hours) < 1e-6
  )
  gene_meta$check_m7 <- with(gene_meta,
    module == 7 & abs(delta_phase_hour - phase_shift_hours) < 1e-6
  )

  cell_meta <- cell_meta %>%
    mutate(
      theta_true = theta_true,
      theta_obs = theta_obs,
      p = p_cell,
      kappa = kappa_i,
      size_factor = sf,
      log_sf = log_sf,
      ZT_true_hour = theta_true / (2 * pi) * 24
    ) %>%
    select(
      cell, sample, group, replicate, ZT_bin_num, ZT_bin,
      theta_true, theta_obs, ZT_true_hour,
      p, kappa, size_factor, log_sf
    )

  sample_meta$n_cells <- cells_per_sample

  list(
    counts = Y,
    gene_meta = gene_meta,
    cell_meta = cell_meta,
    sample_meta = sample_meta,
    sample_effects = list(
      mesor = sample_mesor,
      phase_hour = sample_phase_hour
    ),
    params = list(
      n_replicates = n_replicates,
      cells_per_sample = cells_per_sample,
      ZT_levels = ZT_levels,
      phase_shift_hours = phase_shift_hours,
      delta_phase_tol_hours = delta_phase_tol_hours,
      amp_log2fc_gain = amp_log2fc_gain,
      amp_log2fc_loss = amp_log2fc_loss,
      sigma_rep_mesor = sigma_rep_mesor,
      sigma_rep_phase_hour = sigma_rep_phase_hour
    )
  )
}
```

# Run simulation

```{r}
sim.dat <- simulate_sc_circadian_replicates(
  n_genes_per_module = rep(500, 8),
  n_replicates = 3,
  cells_per_sample = 100,
  ZT_levels = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20),
  phase_kappa_true = 10,
  phase_shift_hours = 3,
  delta_phase_tol_hours = 1.5,
  amp_log2fc_gain = 1.2,
  amp_log2fc_loss = -1.2,
  sigma_rep_mesor = 0.10,
  sigma_rep_phase_hour = 0.30,
  log_sf_sd = 0.45,
  mean_mu = 0.8,
  mean_sd = 1.0,
  amp_meanlog = -0.7,
  amp_sdlog = 0.45,
  disp_meanlog = -1.5,
  disp_sdlog = 0.4,
  dropout_b0 = 1.0,
  dropout_b1 = -0.8,
  p_alpha = 5,
  p_beta = 2,
  kappa_min = 3,
  kappa_max = 30,
  seed = 42,
  show_progress = TRUE
)

qsave(sim.dat, "data/gene_benchmark/simulation_data_replicates.qs")

dim(sim.dat$counts)
table(sim.dat$cell_meta$group, sim.dat$cell_meta$replicate, sim.dat$cell_meta$ZT_bin)
sim.dat$sample_meta
```

# Construct 36-sample pseudobulk count matrix

```{r}
sample_levels <- sim.dat$sample_meta$sample

count.mat <- sapply(
  sample_levels,
  function(s) {
    Matrix::rowSums(
      sim.dat$counts[, sim.dat$cell_meta$sample == s, drop = FALSE]
    )
  }
)

rownames(count.mat) <- rownames(sim.dat$counts)
colnames(count.mat) <- sample_levels
storage.mode(count.mat) <- "integer"

metadata <- sim.dat$sample_meta %>%
  select(sample, group, replicate, ZT_bin_num, ZT_bin, n_cells) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample
metadata <- metadata[colnames(count.mat), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count.mat), rownames(metadata)))

qsave(count.mat, "data/gene_benchmark/pseudobulk_count_36samples.qs")
qsave(metadata,"data/gene_benchmark/pseudobulk_metadata_36samples.qs")

dim(count.mat)
metadata
```

# Checks

```{r}
stopifnot(ncol(count.mat) == 2 * 3 * 6)
stopifnot(all(table(metadata$group, metadata$replicate, metadata$ZT_bin_num) == 1))

cat("Genes:", nrow(count.mat), "\n")
cat("Cells:", ncol(sim.dat$counts), "\n")
cat("Pseudobulk samples:", ncol(count.mat), "\n")

with(metadata, table(group, replicate, ZT_bin_num))
```
